2607.22745.title: AI-generated Images Challenge Visual Trust in High-risk Scenarios
2607.22745.paper_summary: Rapid advances in image generation are eroding the evidentiary value of visual content in settings where authenticity can affect public safety and personal reputation. Yet existing detection benchmarks rarely examine synthetic images in public- and individual-safety contexts, where misleading visual content may carry substantial risks. Here we introduce SafeIMG, a safety-oriented benchmark spanning 12 public- and individual-safety scenarios generated using GPT Image 2. Unlike benchmarks centred on generic imagery and image-level labels, SafeIMG evaluates not only whether detectors recognise synthetic images, but also whether their decisions reflect human-identified anomalies. To this end, SafeIMG provides human annotations that localise suspicious regions and explain local artefacts and higher-level commonsense or physical inconsistencies. We evaluate specialized synthetic-image detectors and vision-language models (VLMs), and find that neither provides reliable detection. The strongest VLM identifies only 49.5% of generated images, whereas the best specialised detector identifies 33.1%, compared with 81.7% accuracy for human evaluators. Model explanations cover only 29.8\% of human-annotated anomalies and predominantly capture local defects in text, faces and hands. Their coverage falls to 15.0% for commonsense conflicts and 12.0% for physical inconsistencies, while detection performance deteriorates further after dissemination-induced image degradation. These findings show that current detectors lack the accuracy, explanatory alignment and robustness needed to evaluate AI-generated images reliably across public- and individual-safety settings.
2607.22745.paper_summary_zh: 快速的影像生成進展正在侵蝕視覺內容在影響公共安全和個人聲譽的情境中的證據價值。<lb/>然而，現有的檢測基準很少檢視在公共和個人安全情境下的合成影像，在這些情境中，誤導性的視覺內容可能帶來重大風險。<lb/>在此，我們介紹了 SafeIMG，一個安全導向的基準，涵蓋了 12 種使用 GPT Image 2 生成的公共和個人安全情境。<lb/>與專注於一般影像和影像級標籤的基準不同，SafeIMG 不僅評估檢測器是否識別合成影像，還評估其決策是否反映人類識別的異常。<lb/>為此，SafeIMG 提供了人類註釋，定位可疑區域並解釋局部工件以及更高層次的常識或物理不一致性。<lb/>我們評估了專門的合成影像檢測器和視覺-語言模型 (VLM)，發現兩者均未提供可靠的檢測。<lb/>最強的 VLM 僅識別 49.5% 的生成影像，而最佳的專門檢測器識別 33.1%，相比之下，人類評估者的準確率為 81.7%。<lb/>模型解釋僅涵蓋 29.8% 的人類註釋異常，主要捕捉文本、面孔和手部的局部缺陷。<lb/>對於常識衝突，其覆蓋率降至 15.0%，對於物理不一致性則降至 12.0%，而在傳播引起的影像劣化後，檢測性能進一步惡化。<lb/>這些發現顯示，當前的檢測器缺乏在公共和個人安全情境中可靠評估 AI 生成影像所需的準確性、解釋一致性和穩健性。
